by
  -- Since FintypeCat has all finite colimits, it has colimits of shape SingleObj G
  -- because SingleObj G is a finite category (it has one object and no non-identity morphisms)
  -- and hence the result follows from the fact that any category with finite colimits
  -- has colimits of shape any finite category.
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.hasColimitsOfShape_of_hasFiniteColimits
  refine ⟨FintypeCat, inferInstance, _, _⟩
  exact inferInstance
  exact inferInstance
